_doc: kind = dash | arc | multi_arc | projectile | homing | stream | beam | aoe_self | aoe_target | zone | self_buff | debuff_aoe | clones. category = physical | special | status. Times in seconds, distances in metres. PP: 'uses' = PP of the move in the main series; PP cost = 100 / uses (so a 100 PP pool gives exactly that many uses). Override with 'pp_cost'; optional 'fatigue' only sets the cooldown weight below (default 10 x PP cost). Accuracy: 'accuracy' in % (as in the games; omitted = never misses, e.g. Swift). On a failed roll auto-aimed moves are physically thrown off target (projectiles/beam/dash/swipes go wide, area strikes land 2-3 m away) and can't damage the aimed target. Homing, aoe_self, stream and stat moves never miss. Cooldown (per move, stops spamming the same move) = windup + duration + weight/40, minimum 2 s for status moves, rounded to 0.1 s. Set 'cooldown' on a move to override. If 'allowed_midair' is false the move cannot be started by a fighter that is in the air (it travels the body along the ground: every kind 'dash' move) and waits for landing; absent = true. A stream with "once": true keeps its cone and duration but damages each target at most once per cast; a target that enters the cone later still takes that one hit (Gust, Sand Attack). "slam": true on a ground aoe_self makes the user crouch, leap (~1.5-2x a normal hop) and slam down, with the aoe/damage resolving on the landing frame instead of at cast (D108); Magnitude scales its jump and impact with the roll. Cut: Mud Sport and the Victreebel stockpile/spit_up/swallow trio have no delivery kind; every other FRLG level-up move up to Lv25 exists. N02: absorb/mega_drain/leech_life fire a green homing orb ("drain": 0.5, turn 2.0 so a dodge is possible) and, on connect only, heal the user for half the damage dealt with a green stream flowing target -> user; sludge lobs ("fx": "lob", 2.2 m arc); self_destruct is an aoe_self that faints the user; charge/growth are single-stat self_buffs (both Sp. Atk here); minimize sets the same evasion as Double Team; encore is a Speed -1 debuff (no repeat-lock mechanic). Gen 9 physics (battle/battle_physics.gd): knockback is scaled by effectiveness (x1.5 super, x0.55 not very, x1.9/x0.35 at 4x/0.25x), crit (x1.4) and the target's weight_kg; "push": metres the move hurls the target (Whirlwind; Roar/Dragon Tail/Circle Throw by id), physical contact moves with power >= 80 also hurl (0.6 m + 1.2 m per 40 power above 80) and a hurled target that hits the fence, a crate/rock or a wall takes up to 8% max HP. "leap": {secs, h, sky} jumps onto the target and hits on landing (Body Slam; Stomp/Bounce/Fly/Heavy Slam by id; sky = out of reach mid-air like Fly). "blink": true vanishes and drops onto the target (Aerial Ace). "tunnel": "dig"|"dive" burrows (invulnerable except to Earthquake/Magnitude, which hit it for double), travels under the target at 'speed' for up to 'range' m and erupts under it. Long-range dashes (range >= 6: Quick Attack, Aqua Jet, Volt Tackle, Sucker Punch) are gap closers the AI uses from afar. multi_target = all_opponents | all_other_pokemon (the latter also hits the user's partner): those moves hit every target and deal 0.75x when one use hits more than one (spread); any other move hits only one target per use (the nearest/first reached). Gen 9 (battle/battle_move_effects.gd, tools/gen9_new_moves.py): 'special' names an extra mechanic (protect, quick_guard, feint, follow_me, after_you, stockpile/spit_up/swallow, heal_weather, roost, rest, life_dew, aromatherapy, haze, light_screen, safeguard, tailwind, gravity, grassy_terrain, sandstorm, rain_dance, toxic_spikes, healing_wish, laser_focus, imprison, metronome, copycat, mimic, mean_look, spite, disable, encore, gastro_acid, worry_seed, flatter, yawn, chain (fury_cutter/rollout, 'chain' = max doublings), echoed_voice, round, assurance, venoshock, stored_power, gyro_ball, electro_ball, flail, low_kick, fell_stinger, covet, pluck, incinerate, belch, ohko, endeavor, fixed ('fixed' HP), super_fang, level_damage, curse, charge, defense_curl, rapid_spin, self_confuse, thunder_wave, no_protect). 'recoil' = fraction of damage dealt taken back; 'flinch' = extra flinch chance; 'tri' = Tri Attack chance; 'self_stats' = user's stage changes once per cast; 'stats' on self_buff = several stages ('stat'/'stages' stay as the main one for the AI); 'charge_stats' = stages on use (Skull Bash); 'hits_range' [2,5] rolls hits/count with the official 35/35/15/15%; 'trap' on stream/zone holds the target (s); 'powder' = no effect on Grass. Statuses: 'toxic' (n/32 max HP on the n-th second) and 'freeze' (2.5 s, thawed by a Fire hit). One turn of a field effect = 1.6 s (screens, Safeguard, Gravity, terrain, weather 8 s; Tailwind 6.4 s); Protect 0.8 s, Quick Guard 1.2 s. Negative priority adds 0.1 s of windup per level.

moves.name: Shadow Punch
moves.desc: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Shadow Sneak
moves.desc: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Double Hit
moves.desc: The user slams the target with a long tail or vines to strike twice in a row.

moves.name: Ally Switch
moves.desc: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with its ally.

moves.name: Psycho Cut
moves.desc: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. High critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Draco Meteor
moves.desc: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Icicle Crash
moves.desc: The user attacks by harshly dropping large icicles onto the target. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Axe Kick
moves.desc: The user kicks up into the air and slams its heel down on the target. It may confuse; if it misses, the user is hurt.

moves.name: Blaze Kick
moves.desc: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. It may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Bone Rush
moves.desc: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Bonemerang
moves.desc: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice, coming and going.

moves.name: Bullet Punch
moves.desc: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Conversion
moves.desc: The user changes its type to match the type of one of the moves it has.

moves.name: Conversion 2
moves.desc: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack it was last hit by.

moves.name: Crabhammer
moves.desc: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Darkest Lariat
moves.desc: The user swings both arms and strikes the target. The user ignores the target's stat changes.

moves.name: Detect
moves.desc: The user protects itself from all attacks for a moment, and reads the attacker: its next hit is a critical hit.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.desc: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target and recovers half the damage dealt. It fails on a target that is awake.

moves.name: Dual Chop
moves.desc: The user attacks the target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Entrainment
moves.desc: The user dances rhythmically with the target and makes it copy the user's Ability.

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.desc: The user charges at the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: First Impression
moves.desc: Although this move has great power and goes first, it only works as the first move the user makes in the battle.

moves.name: Freeze-Dry
moves.desc: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.

moves.name: Guard Split
moves.desc: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def with those of the target.

moves.name: Guard Swap
moves.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the target's.

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.desc: A vicious tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this hits.

moves.name: Hail
moves.desc: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokemon except the Ice type.

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.desc: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status conditions of all the party Pokemon.

moves.name: High Jump Kick
moves.desc: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

moves.name: Kinesis
moves.desc: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Lava Plume
moves.desc: The user torches everything around it with an explosion of scarlet flames. This may also leave those hit with a burn.

moves.name: Lick
moves.desc: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Lovely Kiss
moves.desc: With a scary face, the user tries to give the target a kiss. The flinching target is put to sleep.

moves.name: Mach Punch
moves.desc: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.desc: Moves like Leech Seed and moves that thwart the target are blocked by a barrier of energy and bounced back to the user.

moves.name: Magic Room
moves.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokemon's held items lose their effects for five turns.

moves.name: Metal Burst
moves.desc: The user retaliates against the target that last inflicted damage on it with much greater power. It only works right after being hit.

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.desc: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.desc: The user's attack makes use of the nature around it: the ground it stands on decides which move it becomes.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.desc: Any Pokemon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it leaves the battle.

moves.name: Phantom Force
moves.desc: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target from the shadows. It can also hit a Pokemon using Protect.

moves.name: Poltergeist
moves.desc: The user attacks the target by controlling the target's item or an object nearby. The move fails if there is nothing to hurl.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokemon with a blast of powdery snow. This may also leave them frozen.

moves.name: Power Split
moves.desc: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk with those of the target.

moves.name: Power Swap
moves.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the target's.

moves.name: Psystrike
moves.desc: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

moves.name: Raging Bull
moves.desc: The user charges like a raging bull, breaking barriers such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Raging Fury
moves.desc: The user rampages around, spewing flames. Then it becomes confused.

moves.name: Reflect Type
moves.desc: The user reflects the type of the target, making itself the same type.

moves.name: Retaliate
moves.desc: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. Its power doubles if an ally fainted a moment ago.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.desc: The user mimics the target completely, copying its Ability.

moves.name: Sheer Cold
moves.desc: The target faints instantly if it hits. It is less accurate for non-Ice users, and Ice types are immune.

moves.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Sparkling Aria
moves.desc: The user showers the surroundings with a burst of bubbles while singing. It also cures the burns of those hit.

moves.name: Speed Swap
moves.desc: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.desc: The user flattens the ground it rolls over, ending any terrain, and flattens hills and peaks on its way. It fails with nothing to flatten.

moves.name: Storm Throw
moves.desc: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow and hurls it. This attack always results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.desc: The user blinks away to a safer spot, shaking off traps and holds.

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.desc: The user utilizes the power of the terrain it stands on: its type changes and its power doubles.

moves.name: Transform
moves.desc: The user transforms into a copy of the target: its species, type, stats and moves, but not its HP.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.desc: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

moves.name: Vise Grip
moves.desc: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

moves.name: Vital Throw
moves.desc: The user hurls the target after the target attacks. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Wood Hammer
moves.desc: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Aeroblast
moves.desc: A whirlwind of air is shot at the target. High critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Apple Acid
moves.desc: The user attacks with tart apple acid generated from its body. This lowers the target's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Armor Cannon
moves.desc: The user shoots its own armor out as a broad beam of fire. Its Defense and Sp. Def fall.

moves.name: Bleakwind Storm
moves.desc: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that blow hard enough to cause serious injury. May lower Speed.

moves.name: Blue Flare
moves.desc: The user attacks by engulfing the target in a beautiful, yet fearsome, blue flame. It may burn.

moves.name: Boomburst
moves.desc: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.

moves.name: Burn Up
moves.desc: To inflict damage, the user burns itself out and loses its Fire type.

moves.name: Chatter
moves.desc: The user attacks with sound waves of deafening chatter. It confuses the target.

moves.name: Clanging Scales
moves.desc: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack. Defense falls.

moves.name: Core Enforcer
moves.desc: The user hits with a ray of light. Nullifies the Ability of a target that already moved this turn.

moves.name: Doom Desire
moves.desc: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the target with a concentrated bundle of light.

moves.name: Dragon Energy
moves.desc: The user converts its life-force into energy to attack. The lower the user's HP, the lower the power.

moves.name: Dynamax Cannon
moves.desc: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core. Deals twice the damage to a Dynamaxed target.

moves.name: Electro Drift
moves.desc: The user races at the target with futuristic electric speed. Super-effective hits do extra damage.

moves.name: Electro Shot
moves.desc: The user gathers electricity (raising Sp. Atk) and then fires it. In rain the charge is skipped.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokemon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the power.

moves.name: Fairy Wind
moves.desc: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.

moves.name: Fickle Beam
moves.desc: The user shoots a beam of light. Sometimes a second head joins in, doubling the power.

moves.name: Fiery Dance
moves.desc: Cloaked in flames, the user attacks with a dance. This may also raise the user's Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Flame Burst
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with a burst of flame. Sparks hurt Pokemon next to the target.

moves.name: Fleur Cannon
moves.desc: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Frost Breath
moves.desc: The user blows a cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Fusion Flare
moves.desc: The user brings down a giant flame. Power doubles if Fusion Bolt was used just before.

moves.name: Glaciate
moves.desc: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokemon. This lowers their Speed.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.desc: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokemon using it.

moves.name: Hydro Steam
moves.desc: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move is more powerful in harsh sunlight.

moves.name: Hyperspace Hole
moves.desc: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. Hits through Protect.

moves.name: Infestation
moves.desc: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.

moves.name: Judgment
moves.desc: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. Its type is the user's own.

moves.name: Leaf Tornado
moves.desc: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Lumina Crash
moves.desc: The user attacks by emitting a peculiar light that harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Luster Purge
moves.desc: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Magma Storm
moves.desc: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.

moves.name: Make It Rain
moves.desc: The user attacks by throwing a mass of coins at opposing Pokemon. Sp. Atk falls.

moves.name: Malignant Chain
moves.desc: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping it in a toxic, corrosive chain. May badly poison.

moves.name: Matcha Gotcha
moves.desc: The user fires a blast of tea. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken. May burn.

moves.name: Mind Blown
moves.desc: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. It loses half of its max HP.

moves.name: Mist Ball
moves.desc: A mistlike flurry of down envelops the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Moongeist Beam
moves.desc: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. Ignores the effects of the target's Ability.

moves.name: Mystical Power
moves.desc: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user's best stat.

moves.name: Nature’s Madness
moves.desc: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.

moves.name: Night Daze
moves.desc: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave from its body. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Oblivion Wing
moves.desc: The user absorbs its target's HP. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage taken.

moves.name: Octazooka
moves.desc: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target's face or eyes. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

moves.name: Origin Pulse
moves.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokemon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and vivid blue.

moves.name: Overdrive
moves.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokemon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

moves.name: Parabolic Charge
moves.desc: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken.

moves.name: Photon Geyser
moves.desc: The user attacks a target with a pillar of light. It becomes physical if the user's Attack is higher.

moves.name: Prismatic Laser
moves.desc: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Psycho Boost
moves.desc: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil sharply reduces the user's Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Relic Song
moves.desc: The user sings an ancient song. This may also induce sleep in opposing Pokemon.

moves.name: Revelation Dance
moves.desc: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The move's type varies depending on the user's type.

moves.name: Rising Voltage
moves.desc: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. Power doubles on Electric Terrain.

moves.name: Roar of Time
moves.desc: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Ruination
moves.desc: The user summons a ruinous disaster and cuts the target's HP by half.

moves.name: Sandsear Storm
moves.desc: The user attacks with a storm of scorching sand. This may also burn opposing Pokemon.

moves.name: Searing Shot
moves.desc: An inferno of scarlet flames torches everything around the user. It may also leave the targets burned.

moves.name: Secret Sword
moves.desc: The user cuts with its resolute horn. This attack does physical damage.

moves.name: Seed Flare
moves.desc: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. This may harshly lower the target's Sp. Def.

moves.name: Shell Trap
moves.desc: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode.

moves.name: Signal Beam
moves.desc: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Snipe Shot
moves.desc: The user ignores the effects of moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit its chosen target.

moves.name: Spacial Rend
moves.desc: The user tears the target along with the space around it. High critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Springtide Storm
moves.desc: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokemon in a whirlwind of love and hate. May lower Attack.

moves.name: Steam Eruption
moves.desc: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Syrup Bomb
moves.desc: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed to drop each turn.

moves.name: Tachyon Cutter
moves.desc: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Techno Blast
moves.desc: The user fires a beam of light whose type depends on the Drive held by the user.

moves.name: Tera Starstorm
moves.desc: The user bombards the target with a stream of energy. Used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form.

moves.name: Thunder Cage
moves.desc: The user traps the target in a cage of electricity for four to five turns.

moves.name: Thunderclap
moves.desc: The user attacks with a blast of lightning moving at ultrafast speed. This move fails if the target isn't readying an attack.

moves.name: Torch Song
moves.desc: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Twin Beam
moves.desc: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Water Shuriken
moves.desc: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Wildbolt Storm
moves.desc: The user summons a thunderous tempest and attacks with lightning and wind. May paralyze opposing Pokemon.

moves.name: Magic Powder
moves.desc: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder. The target becomes a Psychic type.

moves.name: Milk Drink
moves.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Mind Reader
moves.desc: The user senses the target's movements, making its next move certain to hit.

moves.name: Mud Sport
moves.desc: The user covers itself with mud. Electric-type moves are weakened for a while.

moves.name: No Retreat
moves.desc: This move raises all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

moves.name: Noble Roar
moves.desc: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Obstruct
moves.desc: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Contact harshly lowers the attacker's Defense.

moves.name: Octolock
moves.desc: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. Defense and Sp. Def fall every turn.

moves.name: Odor Sleuth
moves.desc: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. It also enables an evasive target to be hit.

moves.name: Parting Shot
moves.desc: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk. Then it switches out.

moves.name: Power Trick
moves.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.

moves.name: Psycho Shift
moves.desc: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.

moves.name: Purify
moves.desc: The user heals the target's status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user's own HP.

moves.name: Quash
moves.desc: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

moves.name: Refresh
moves.desc: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.

moves.name: Revival Blessing
moves.desc: The user bestows a loving blessing on a party Pokemon that has fainted, reviving it with half its max HP.

moves.name: Rototiller
moves.desc: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. Raises Attack and Sp. Atk of Grass types.

moves.name: Shed Tail
moves.desc: The user creates a substitute for itself by splitting off its tail, and then switches out.

moves.name: Shift Gear
moves.desc: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack and sharply raising its Speed.

moves.name: Shore Up
moves.desc: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.

moves.name: Silk Trap
moves.desc: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed of attackers that make direct contact.

moves.name: Sketch
moves.desc: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target.

moves.name: Spicy Extract
moves.desc: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply raising the target's Attack and harshly lowering its Defense.

moves.name: Spiky Shield
moves.desc: The user protects itself and damages attackers that make direct contact with it.

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.desc: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed upon switching in.

moves.name: Stuff Cheeks
moves.desc: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply boosts its Defense stat.

moves.name: Tail Glow
moves.desc: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Take Heart
moves.desc: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def.

moves.name: Tar Shot
moves.desc: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering its Speed. The target becomes weaker to Fire.

moves.name: Tearful Look
moves.desc: The user gets teary eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit, lowering its Attack and Sp. Atk.

moves.name: Teatime
moves.desc: The user has teatime with all the Pokemon on the field. Each Pokemon eats its held Berry.

moves.name: Tidy Up
moves.desc: The user tidies up, removing hazards and substitutes, and boosts its Attack and Speed.

moves.name: Topsy-Turvy
moves.desc: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

moves.name: Torment
moves.desc: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

moves.name: Toxic Thread
moves.desc: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Trick-or-Treat
moves.desc: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target's type.
